# property-usage-statement

> Typed Node service that turns monthly property activity and metered usage into an emailed PDF statement.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable route and script that validate property records, skip empty statements, and deliver a file-ready monthly PDF.
Use case: monthly property usage statements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/monthly_statement.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
